title: Separate the chart-421 return from the old owner-203 demand
body:
## Mathematical result

In the named 1934=D+h family with fixed exterior stock, a six-coordinate displacement preserves the enlarged source banks and early feedback through 3399 and 3400 while flipping owner 203. An independent 131,072-selector census gives zero simultaneous returns of owners 679 and 203. If three chart-635 arrivals stay fixed, owner 221 survives a change to the fourth arrival exactly when that change belongs to their span.

## Sources

Canonical main e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. #7830 87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15 and #8006 4035f150285513852cab8d00b8bfc233c699ea0a. #8008 pins the compatible funded incidence shape. The separator fixes the specified exterior stocks and does not cover arbitrary other payload equations.

## Validation

Cold top and nested hashes and python3 -I -B verify_421.py passed source alignment, eight quotient cases, all selectors, and a causal literal owner-221 corruption control.

## Open next questions

Change the exterior stock or 1934 source formula and recheck the deadline, both full operators and charged ranks.
